leader.note: the one element that stands for its whole group

path-compression.note: after find(x), x points straight to the leader, so the next find is fast

in-degree.ar: درجة الدخول (عدد الأسهم الداخلة إلى الرأس)
in-degree.note: how many arrows point to this vertex

topological-order.note: an order of the vertices where every arrow goes from left to right

combination.note: a way to choose r items from n when order does not matter

precompute.note: calculate once at the start, then reuse many times

interactive.note: your program and the judge send messages to each other

flush.note: send the printed text now, do not keep it in memory

output-buffer.note: a place in memory where printed text waits before it is really sent

fermat.note: for a prime p, and a not a multiple of p: the inverse of a is a^(p-2) mod p

segment-tree.note: a structure that answers range questions and allows changes, O(log n) each

fenwick-tree.note: a short piece of code for prefix sums when the array changes

spanning-tree.note: a set of edges with no cycle that connects all vertices
